title: Iron tower shield

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Iron tower shield is the third tower shield. It has more block armor compared to Banded shield but reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10% with a lack of being able to parry, which lets the Banded shield have more block armor when parrying than the Iron tower shield has in normal blocking.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
• Serpent scale shield can also be crafted with Iron while having more block power and less movement penalty, provided the player is able to hunt Serpents.

full_text:
Iron tower shield

Internal ID: ShieldIronTower | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Iron x10 | Movement speed: -10%

Introduction. The Iron tower shield is the third tower shield. It has more block armor compared to Banded shield but reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10% with a lack of being able to parry, which lets the Banded shield have more block armor when parrying than the Iron tower shield has in normal blocking.

Notes. • When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
• Serpent scale shield can also be crafted with Iron while having more block power and less movement penalty, provided the player is able to hunt Serpents.
